author: Literature Devil
description:
Are Star Wars fans losing interest in the Disney Star Wars Sequel Trilogy? A new May the 4th report suggests that across multiple generations, fans are still watching and celebrating the Original Trilogy, the Prequel Trilogy, Andor, and The Clone Wars — while the Star Wars Sequels seem to be fading from the conversation.

What happened to “Star Wars for the new generation”? And did The Last Jedi really age like The Empire Strikes Back, or has the Sequel Trilogy failed to become timeless?

Good Star Wars stories last forever. The Sequels? Maybe not.
